opening.argument: The material directly promotes a downloadable MetaMask trading bot, calling it a “SAFE DOWNLOAD” and directing viewers to obtain it [1]. Its instructions tell viewers to download an archive, open “GhostSniper.exe,” start MetaMask, and “Enjoy your crypto!” [2]. The displayed utility reinforces that promotion: it presents a token-contract field, a BNB-amount field, an APPROVE control, and BUY and SELL controls [3]. Shown over a MetaMask account, the interface also includes token-trading fields and status or log panels [4]. These facts establish a trading-bot or funded-contract-returns pitch, while the available evidence does not establish that the executable was malicious, that a transaction completed, or that funds were lost.

citations.quote: UPDATE METAMASK TRADING BOT x Pancakeswap&Poocoin Auto Trading x TUTORIAL x SAFE DOWNLOAD
